semiconductor_relevance: High — Hae Kwang Co., Ltd. specializes in raised access floor systems specifically designed for high-tech environments such as semiconductor fabs and cleanrooms.
summary: Hae Kwang Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and installs all-aluminum raised access floor systems tailored for semiconductor fabrication facilities and cleanrooms. Their products are engineered to support demanding loads and ensure stability, making them suitable for high-tech environments.
